notes.title: F2D Winter update
notes.notes:
[h1]F2D is part of the Steam Co-op Fest! 🎉[/h1]

To celebrate, we’re dropping a huge update packed with awesome new content

[h2]What’s New? 🚦[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]New Tracks: [/b]Hungary 🇭🇺  / Australia  🇦🇺 / PlayRug 🎮
[*] [b]New Features: [/b]💰 Invest in next year’s car – Shape your future on the track!🏆 Classic Career option – Challenge the legends of the sport! (Will add a classic car for the player in future update)
[*] [b]Fresh Liveries:[/b] Tons of new designs to customize your car! 🏎️  (Auxence you finally have your own livery)
[*] [b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
Smarter AI & smoother gameplay
Grapical tweaks & performance boosts
[*] [b]Racing Wheel Support[/b] (with Force Feedback!) Why? 🤷‍♂️ No idea, but it’s here, and it works! (Thrustmaster only with new wheels coming soon !)
[/list]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h2]Share Your Moments With Us! 🎥[/h2]

As always, with great updates come… possible bugs! 🐛
Your feedback is super valuable, so let me know if you spot anything!

And if you’ve got ideas for future features you would like to see added, i love to hear them !

[b]🔗 [url=https://discord.gg/586Ja7TBSw]Discord[/url] | [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/F2D/]Reddit[/url][/b]

🏁 See you on the track! 🏎️💨

notes.title: 🎄🏎️ F2D Holiday Update – Celebrate the Offseason in Style! ☃️❄️
notes.notes:
The holiday season is here, and F2D is ready to bring some festive fun to your racing experience! Whether you're missing F1 or just looking for a snowy adrenaline rush F2D has got you covered !

[h1]🎅 Christmas Event: Snowy Castelet Track[/h1]

Test your skills on a snow-covered Castellet and compete against players from around the globe in our weekly holiday challenge. Can you set the fastest lap and claim the top spot?

[h3]💡 Free for Everyone![/h3]
This special event is open to all players—including those trying the free demo. Jump in, no purchase necessary, and join the fun!

[h3]🎁 Claim Your Spot on the Leaderboard![/h3]
The Christmas Event starts this weekend—grab your snow tires and race for glory! Don’t forget, the event is accessible through the free demo, so everyone can join the celebration. The top time as well as a random winner will get unique rewards ! (Sponsorize the race corner of your choice and win steam keys !)

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thank you for supporting F2D and being part of this incredible journey. Wishing you a joyful holiday season and an exciting time on the snowy track!

Don’t forget to share your feedback, suggestions, and moments on our community hubs:
[b]🔗 [url=https://discord.gg/586Ja7TBSw]Discord[/url] | [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/F2D/]Reddit[/url][/b]


See you on the leaderboards.
